assessment.headline: DAY 37. Trump: '48 hours — all Hell.' F-15 crew missing. Green Sanvi reaches Mumbai tomorrow. The most dangerous day begins.
assessment.body:
This is it. The moment the entire war has been building toward.

Trump posted this morning: 'Remember when I gave Iran ten days to MAKE A DEAL or OPEN UP THE HORMUZ STRAIT. Time is running out — 48 hours before all Hell will reign down on them.' Senator Graham: 'I totally support overwhelming military force.'

The April 6 deadline expires TOMORROW at 8 PM ET (Monday 5:30 AM IST). If no deal:
• Power plants will be struck
• Desalination plants may be targeted (90% of Kuwait's water)
• Oil could spike past $130 overnight
• Indian markets open Monday into potential chaos

Meanwhile, the F-15E Weapons System Officer remains missing in Iran — Day 2. Iran offered $60K bounty. State TV urged civilians to shoot at US aircraft overhead. Two Black Hawk rescue helicopters were hit. IRGC and governor deny capture but search is ongoing in the mountains of Khuzestan.

Rosatom is evacuating 200 staff from Bushehr nuclear plant. A projectile damaged a building nearby, killing 1 security staff. Only ~100 Russian staff will remain at Iran's only nuclear reactor.

CNN confirms India is buying Iranian fuel under a US temporary license for 140M barrels. India's energy diplomacy is now playing ALL sides — buying from USA (#1 LPG supplier), Russia, Iran, and Australia simultaneously. This is strategically brilliant but diplomatically risky.

For India (Day 37, 9:15 AM):
• Green Sanvi reaches MUMBAI TOMORROW with 46,650 MT LPG
• 9 carriers crossed. 17 ships + 460 seafarers remain
• Green Asha + Jag Vikram confirmed next
• 60 days fuel stock. LPG 30+ days. Refineries >100%
• Rupee 93.19 (RBI NDF ban holding)
• India supplying fuel to 5 neighbors
• But: Brent $109. April 6 deadline tomorrow. F-15 missing.

The next 24 hours will determine:
1. Does the April 6 deadline trigger 'all Hell'?
2. Is the F-15 WSO alive, dead, or captured?
3. Does the UN Security Council vote pass?
4. How does Monday's market open react?

India enters what could be the most consequential Monday since the war began. Green Sanvi arriving is the good news. Everything else is on a knife's edge.
